description: Source code for the VdaVideoFramePool class, managing video frame buffers for Chrome OS media GPU processing.

classes.name: VdaVideoFramePool
classes.description: Manages a pool of video frames for hardware-accelerated video decoding on Chrome OS.

methods.name: VdaVideoFramePool
methods.description: Constructor initializing the video frame pool with delegate and task runner.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up the frame pool with specified format, size, and frame count.

methods.name: ImportFrameThunk
methods.description: Static helper to import a frame into the pool asynchronously.

methods.name: ImportFrame
methods.description: Imports a frame into the pool.

methods.name: GetFrame
methods.description: Retrieves a frame from the pool, wrapped with specified visible and natural size.

methods.name: IsExhausted
methods.description: Checks if the frame pool is empty.

methods.name: NotifyWhenFrameAvailable
methods.description: Sets a callback to notify when a frame becomes available.

methods.name: ReleaseAllFrames
methods.description: Placeholder for releasing all frames (not yet implemented).

methods.name: GetGpuBufferLayout
methods.description: Returns the current GPU buffer layout.

methods.name: CallFrameAvailableCbIfNeeded
methods.description: Invokes the frame available callback if conditions are met.
